claim: Independent shortest paths are not collision-free in dense MAPF tasks.
Prioritized planning greatly reduces collisions relative to independent paths.
evidence: Mean residual conflicts fall from 54.75 to 1.62.

claim: PolicyLNS+PP is a faithful LNS/PP hybrid but only approximates MARL.
evidence: Destroy/repair LNS and prioritized space-time repair are implemented; MARL is represented by a transparent conflict-pressure policy rather than learned neural MARL.
8 families and 64 method-instance rows were evaluated.
